card.title: Airports
card.passage: Many people go to airports to travel. Some airports have nice shops and restaurants, so people also enjoy shopping and eating there. Children like watching airplanes from the windows.

steps.t: Hello. My name is Ms. Brown. May I have your name, please?
Thank you. This is the Grade 3 test. OK? How are you today?
Let's start the test. Here is your card.
First, please read the passage silently for 20 seconds.
All right. Now, please read it aloud.
Now, I'll ask you five questions.
Number 1. Please look at the passage. Why do people also enjoy shopping and eating at some airports?
Number 2. Please look at the picture. How many suitcases are there?
Number 3. Please look at the woman. What is she doing?
Now, please turn the card over.
Number 4. What do you usually do on weekends?
Number 5. Do you like to travel?

follow.no: What do you want to do this summer?

steps.t: This is the end of the test. Could I have the card back, please?
Thank you. You may go now.

points: 意味のまとまりで区切る(…restaurants, / so people…)

q1.q: Why do people also enjoy shopping and eating at some airports?
q1.ja: なぜ、いくつかの空港では買い物や食事も楽しめるのですか。
model: Because they have nice shops and restaurants.
points: so の前の部分が答え
Some airports を they に置きかえる

q2.ja: スーツケースはいくつありますか。

q3.ja: 女性は何をしていますか。

q4.q: What do you usually do on weekends?
q4.ja: ふだん週末に何をしますか。
model: I usually play soccer with my friends.
I usually study English at home.
points: 主語と動詞のある文で

model.yes: Yes. → I like to visit new places. I went to Kyoto with my family last year.
model.no: No. → I want to go camping with my friends.
